FORM NO. 3
G. 65M-1-39
HSM.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch Division,
REPORT

File No. S. B. RY 8975
Date January 25, 1939.

Subject (in full) Advertisement appearing in Personal Column of North-China
Daily News dated January 24, 1939.
Made by D.S. Fitts Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.D.

The attached advertisement was handed to the
North-China Daily News by a responsible foreigner
on the understanding that the name of the person
inserting it was not revealed to anybody.

Mr. R.W. DAVIS, manager of the journal,
when interviewed, however, stated that Mr. J.B.
POWELL of the China Weekly Review, could give
further details in regard to the subject matter of
the insertion.

In view of the fact that Mr. DAVIS gave this
information in confidence, however, Mr. POWELL has
not been approached.

FILE
P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.)
25/1.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科第一股，
报告

档案号 S. B. RY 8975
日期 1939年1月25日。

事由（全称） 1939年1月24日《字林西报》个人专栏刊登的广告。
呈报人 D.S. Fitts 转呈人 C. Crawford. 副总监。

所附广告由一名负责任的外国人交给《字林西报》，条件是不得向任何人透露刊登者的姓名。

然而，该报经理 R.W. DAVIS 先生在接受问询时表示，《密勒氏评论报》的 J.B. POWELL 先生可以提供有关该刊登事项主题的更多细节。

鉴于 DAVIS 先生是在保密前提下提供此信息的，因此未联系 POWELL 先生。

存档
助理专员致特务科总监
1月25日。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

JAN 24 1939

Personal
WARNING. Chinese young women who are being recruited for Manchukuo, with promises of lucrative positions with firms of a certain nationality in Hsinking, Mukden and Harbin, should beware of tragic consequences as those responsible have other objects in mind. Readers should show this to their Chinese associates.
